intitule: Resource: Present Perfect vs. Present Perfect Continuous

enonce.texte: Analyze the following sentences. Identify whether the underlined verb is in the Present Perfect Simple or the Present Perfect Continuous. Justify your choice.

questions.reponse: 1. Present Perfect Simple (result emphasized), 2. Present Perfect Continuous (duration emphasized), 3. Present Perfect Simple (completed action with result), 4. Present Perfect Continuous (ongoing action)

sousQuestions.texte: I have read that book three times.
sousQuestions.reponse: Present Perfect Simple - emphasizes the completed action and the result (knowing the book).

sousQuestions.texte: She has been waiting for an hour.
sousQuestions.reponse: Present Perfect Continuous - emphasizes the duration of the action.
Present Perfect Simple - emphasizes the completion of the action.

sousQuestions.texte: We have been studying English for two years.
sousQuestions.reponse: Present Perfect Continuous - emphasizes the ongoing nature of the action.

intitule: Resource: Time Expressions with Present Perfect

enonce.texte: Complete the sentences with the correct time expression: for, since, already, yet, just.

sousQuestions.texte: She has lived in Douala ______ ten years.

intitule: Resource: Comparing Present Perfect and Past Simple

enonce.texte: Choose the correct tense: Present Perfect or Past Simple. Explain your choice.

questions.reponse: 1. have visited, 2. went, 3. have known, 4. met

sousQuestions.reponse: have visited - Present Perfect for life experiences.
went - Past Simple for a specific time in the past.
have known - Present Perfect for a situation that started in the past and continues.
met - Past Simple for a specific past event.

enonce.texte: Use the Present Perfect to describe your life experiences. Write a paragraph about the things you have done and places you have visited.

questions.reponse: Example: I have traveled to several African countries. I have visited Nigeria and Ghana. I have never been to Europe. I have learned to speak English and French. I have also lived in Yaoundé for two years.

enonce.texte: Write a dialogue between two friends who haven't seen each other for a long time. Use the Present Perfect Continuous to talk about what they have been doing since they last met.

questions.reponse: Example: A: Hi, it's great to see you! What have you been doing? B: I have been working as a teacher. I have been living in Douala for three years. What about you? A: I have been studying at the university. I have been learning English.

sousQuestions.texte: He has worked here ______ three years.
We have known them ______ we were children.
She has studied French ______ six months.

intitule: Competence: Telling a Story Using Different Tenses

enonce.texte: Write a short story about your life. Use the Present Perfect, Present Perfect Continuous, and Past Simple appropriately.

questions.reponse: Example: I have lived in Cameroon my whole life. I have been studying English since primary school. I have visited many places in the country. Last year, I went to the Far North. I have been learning new things every day.
